title: WASP‑96b's Water Vapor Surprise

scenes.text: WASP‑96b holds water vapor in its cloud tops
James Webb Telescope detected H₂O absorption lines in the planet’s spectrum.
The same spectrum also shows methane, a key greenhouse gas.
Despite being a hot Jupiter, WASP‑96b’s clouds are like Earth’s rain‑clouds!
Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: WASP‑96b, a gas giant 3.5 AU from its star, surprisingly shows Earth‑like water clouds in its upper atmosphere. Follow for daily science!
